verdict.rationale: A probe confirms that Stripe documents an official CLI at docs.stripe.com/stripe-cli. That CLI is Stripe's own tool and covers the platform Issuing is built on. Beyond its existence, the pack contains no detail on the CLI. missing for 10: evidence of Issuing-specific CLI commands (cards, cardholders, authorizations), CLI documentation content, AI-native or agent workflow usage via the CLI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
